title: Within-task hazards of AI agents: unidentified by time-horizon curves, identified by repeated runs
abstract: arXiv:2611.32415v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The time horizon of an AI agent is read off a curve: the probability that the agent completes a task, plotted against the time a human needs for it. Several recent analyses fit survival models to this curve and conclude that agents' hazard of failure declines as a task goes on. The curve cannot support that conclusion. Every log-logistic horizon curve with slope $\beta\le1$ is a mixture of constant-hazard curves, and in a proportional-hazards frailty model the same curve is produced by every within-task Weibull shape $k\ge\beta$. If runs of a task are conditionally independent, repeated runs restore identification within this model: the probability that two runs both succeed is the single-run curve shifted by $1/k$ on the $\log_2$ time axis. translated_title: AI智能体的任务内风险：时间视野曲线无法识别，重复运行可以识别
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.32415v1 公告类型：cross。摘要：AI智能体的时间视野是从一条曲线上读出的：该曲线给出智能体完成某任务的概率，横轴为人类完成该任务所需的时间。近期的若干分析对这条曲线拟合生存模型，并得出结论：随着任务的推进，智能体失败的风险（hazard）会下降。但这条曲线无法支持该结论。每条斜率 β≤1 的对数-逻辑斯蒂（log-logistic）视野曲线都是恒定风险曲线的混合；在比例风险脆弱性（frailty）模型中，任何任务内威布尔形状参数 k≥β 都会产生同一条曲线。如果同一任务的各次运行在条件上相互独立，那么重复运行可以在该模型内恢复可识别性：两次运行都成功的概率等于单次运行曲线在对数₂时间轴上平移 1/k 后的结果。在威布尔形式之外，这两条曲线之间的水平距离仍然能够指示风险的方向：如果平均任务内风险是非递增的，则该距离至少为……
tldr: 该论文证明仅凭时间视野（任务完成率）曲线在统计上无法识别AI智能体任务内失败风险是否随任务推进而下降，并提出利用同一任务的条件独立重复运行（即两次运行均成功的概率曲线相对单次曲线的对数轴平移量）来恢复对任务内风险的可识别性。
en_tdlr: Time-horizon curves alone cannot statistically identify whether an AI agent's within-task failure hazard declines over the course of a task, but repeated conditionally independent runs—through the probability that two runs both succeed—restore this identification.
